articles.summary: Daily Superculture®Pet Immune supplementation produced statistically significant improvements in coat softness and glossiness in healthy dogs. Effects were sustained over 90 days; placebo showed no significant change at any time point. This page contains an overview of the data presented at the 2026 ACVIM Forum.
